name: Pizza WhatsApp - Customer and Admin Router

parameters.query:
WITH customer AS (
    INSERT INTO customers (
        whatsapp_phone,
        name,
        updated_at
    )
    VALUES ($1, NULLIF(BTRIM($2::text), ''), NOW())
    ON CONFLICT (whatsapp_phone)
    DO UPDATE SET
        name = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.name, ''), customers.name),
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING id, whatsapp_phone, name
),
session AS (
    INSERT INTO conversation_sessions (customer_id)
    SELECT id FROM customer
    ON CONFLICT (customer_id)
    DO UPDATE SET updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING *
)
SELECT
    customer.id AS customer_id,
    customer.whatsapp_phone,
    customer.name,
    session.id AS session_id,
    session.cart,
    session.order_type,
    session.delivery_address,
    session.awaiting_confirmation,
    session.awaiting_human,
    session.delivery_name,
    session.recent_messages,
    session.order_status,
    session.active_order_id,
    session.pending_items
FROM customer
JOIN session ON session.customer_id = customer.id;

SELECT
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(m) ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.id)
         FROM active_restaurant_menu_for_ai m),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS menu,
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT JSONB_OBJECT_AGG(r.rule_key, r.rule_value)
         FROM restaurant_menu_rules r
         WHERE r.active = TRUE),
        '{}'::JSONB
    ) AS menu_rules;

WITH input_payload AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof($1::jsonb) = 'array' THEN $1::jsonb ELSE '[]'::jsonb END AS items
),
locked_session AS (
  SELECT cs.id, cs.cart
  FROM conversation_sessions cs
  WHERE cs.customer_id = $2::bigint
  FOR UPDATE
),
new_items_raw AS (
  SELECT elem, ordinal
  FROM input_payload ip
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(ip.items) WITH ORDINALITY AS raw(elem, ordinal)
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(elem) = 'object'
),
new_menu_items AS (
  SELECT
    (elem->>'menu_item_id')::bigint AS menu_item_id,
    (elem->>'variant_id')::bigint AS variant_id,
    COALESCE(elem->>'quantity', '1')::int AS quantity
  FROM new_items_raw
  WHERE elem->>'record_type' = 'menu_item'
    AND COALESCE(elem->>'menu_item_id', '') ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$'
    AND COALESCE(elem->>'variant_id', '') ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$'
    AND COALESCE(elem->>'quantity', '1') ~ '^-?[0-9]{1,9}$'
),
validated_new_menu_items AS (
  SELECT
    format('menu:%s:%s', ni.menu_item_id, v.id) AS line_key,
    'menu_item'::text AS record_type,
    ni.menu_item_id,
    v.id AS variant_id,
    NULL::bigint AS deal_id,
    mi.name AS item_name,
    mi.category,
    v.variant_label AS size,
    ni.quantity,
    v.price::numeric AS price,
    '[]'::jsonb AS selected_components
  FROM new_menu_items ni
  JOIN restaurant_menu_variants v
    ON v.id = ni.variant_id AND v.menu_item_id = ni.menu_item_id AND v.active = TRUE
  JOIN restaurant_menu_items mi ON mi.id = ni.menu_item_id AND mi.active = TRUE
),
new_deal_items AS (
  SELECT
    (raw.elem->>'deal_id')::bigint AS deal_id,
    COALESCE(raw.elem->>'quantity', '1')::int AS quantity,
    canonical.selected_components
  FROM new_items_raw raw
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(component ORDER BY component::text), '[]'::jsonb) AS selected_components
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(raw.elem->'selected_components', '[]'::jsonb)) AS component
  ) canonical
  WHERE raw.elem->>'record_type' = 'deal'
    AND COALESCE(raw.elem->>'deal_id', '') ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$'
    AND COALESCE(raw.elem->>'quantity', '1') ~ '^-?[0-9]{1,9}$'
    AND (NOT raw.elem ? 'selected_components' OR jsonb_typeof(raw.elem->'selected_components') = 'array')
),
validated_new_deal_items AS (
  SELECT
    format('deal:%s:%s', ndi.deal_id, ndi.selected_components::text) AS line_key,
    'deal'::text AS record_type,
    NULL::bigint AS menu_item_id,
    NULL::bigint AS variant_id,
    d.id AS deal_id,
    d.name AS item_name,
    d.category,
    NULL::text AS size,
    ndi.quantity,
    d.price::numeric AS price,
    ndi.selected_components
  FROM new_deal_items ndi
  JOIN restaurant_deals d ON d.id = ndi.deal_id AND d.active = TRUE
),
validated_new_items AS (
  SELECT * FROM validated_new_menu_items
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM validated_new_deal_items
),
incoming_items AS (
  SELECT
    line_key, record_type, menu_item_id, variant_id, deal_id,
    MAX(item_name) AS item_name, MAX(category) AS category, MAX(size) AS size,
    SUM(quantity)::int AS quantity_delta, BOOL_OR(quantity = 0) AS remove_requested,
    MAX(price) AS price, selected_components
  FROM validated_new_items
  GROUP BY line_key, record_type, menu_item_id, variant_id, deal_id, selected_components
),
existing_items_raw AS (
  SELECT existing
  FROM locked_session ls
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(ls.cart->'items') = 'array' THEN ls.cart->'items' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
  ) AS existing
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(existing) = 'object'
),
existing_menu_items AS (
  SELECT
    (existing->>'menu_item_id')::bigint AS menu_item_id,
    (existing->>'variant_id')::bigint AS variant_id,
    (existing->>'quantity')::int AS quantity
  FROM existing_items_raw
  WHERE existing->>'record_type' = 'menu_item'
    AND COALESCE(existing->>'menu_item_id', '') ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$'
    AND COALESCE(existing->>'variant_id', '') ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$'
    AND COALESCE(existing->>'quantity', '') ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'
),
validated_existing_menu_items AS (
  SELECT
    format('menu:%s:%s', emi.menu_item_id, v.id) AS line_key,
    'menu_item'::text AS record_type, emi.menu_item_id, v.id AS variant_id, NULL::bigint AS deal_id,
    mi.name AS item_name, mi.category, v.variant_label AS size, emi.quantity,
    v.price::numeric AS price, '[]'::jsonb AS selected_components
  FROM existing_menu_items emi
  JOIN restaurant_menu_variants v
    ON v.id = emi.variant_id AND v.menu_item_id = emi.menu_item_id AND v.active = TRUE
  JOIN restaurant_menu_items mi ON mi.id = emi.menu_item_id AND mi.active = TRUE
),
existing_deal_items AS (
  SELECT
    (raw.existing->>'deal_id')::bigint AS deal_id,
    (raw.existing->>'quantity')::int AS quantity,
    canonical.selected_components
  FROM existing_items_raw raw
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(component ORDER BY component::text), '[]'::jsonb) AS selected_components
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(raw.existing->'selected_components', '[]'::jsonb)) AS component
  ) canonical
  WHERE raw.existing->>'record_type' = 'deal'
    AND COALESCE(raw.existing->>'deal_id', '') ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$'
    AND COALESCE(raw.existing->>'quantity', '') ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'
    AND (NOT raw.existing ? 'selected_components' OR jsonb_typeof(raw.existing->'selected_components') = 'array')
),
validated_existing_deal_items AS (
  SELECT
    format('deal:%s:%s', edi.deal_id, edi.selected_components::text) AS line_key,
    'deal'::text AS record_type, NULL::bigint AS menu_item_id, NULL::bigint AS variant_id, d.id AS deal_id,
    d.name AS item_name, d.category, NULL::text AS size, edi.quantity,
    d.price::numeric AS price, edi.selected_components
  FROM existing_deal_items edi
  JOIN restaurant_deals d ON d.id = edi.deal_id AND d.active = TRUE
),
validated_existing_items AS (
  SELECT * FROM validated_existing_menu_items
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM validated_existing_deal_items
),
combined_items AS (
  SELECT ei.*
  FROM validated_existing_items ei
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM incoming_items ni WHERE ni.line_key = ei.line_key AND ni.remove_requested
  )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    line_key, record_type, menu_item_id, variant_id, deal_id, item_name, category, size,
    quantity_delta AS quantity, price, selected_components
  FROM incoming_items
  WHERE NOT remove_requested AND quantity_delta <> 0
),
merged_items AS (
  SELECT
    line_key, record_type, menu_item_id, variant_id, deal_id,
    MAX(item_name) AS item_name, MAX(category) AS category, MAX(size) AS size,
    SUM(quantity)::int AS quantity, MAX(price) AS price, selected_components
  FROM combined_items
  GROUP BY line_key, record_type, menu_item_id, variant_id, deal_id, selected_components
  HAVING SUM(quantity) > 0
),
final_items AS (
  SELECT record_type, menu_item_id, variant_id, deal_id, item_name, category, size,
         quantity, price, selected_components, price * quantity AS line_total
  FROM merged_items
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE conversation_sessions cs
  SET cart = jsonb_build_object(
        'items',
        (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(fi) ORDER BY fi.record_type, COALESCE(fi.menu_item_id, fi.deal_id), fi.variant_id, fi.selected_components::text), '[]'::jsonb) FROM final_items fi)
      ),
      order_status = 'draft',
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM locked_session ls
  WHERE cs.id = ls.id
  RETURNING cs.cart
)
SELECT
  u.cart,
  jsonb_array_length(ip.items) AS input_item_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM validated_new_items) AS accepted_item_count,
  jsonb_array_length(ip.items) - (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM validated_new_items) AS rejected_item_count
FROM updated u CROSS JOIN input_payload ip;

parameters.toolDescription: Validate and update the customer's draft cart. Pass a JSON array string. Menu line format: {"record_type":"menu_item","menu_item_id":1,"variant_id":3,"quantity":1}. Deal line format: {"record_type":"deal","deal_id":5,"quantity":1,"selected_components":[...]}. Positive quantity adds that amount to the matching line; a negative quantity decreases it; quantity 0 removes the entire exact matching line. A menu line matches only the same menu_item_id and variant_id. A deal matches only the same deal_id and exact selected_components configuration; when removing a configured deal, repeat its selected_components from CURRENT_SESSION. Use only IDs from MENU_DATA. Inspect accepted_item_count and rejected_item_count and never claim rejected lines were added.

parameters.query: UPDATE conversation_sessions SET order_type = $2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE customer_id = $1 RETURNING order_type;

UPDATE conversation_sessions
SET delivery_name = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), delivery_name),
    delivery_address = COALESCE(NULLIF($3, ''), delivery_address),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE customer_id = $1
RETURNING delivery_name, delivery_address;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Upsert Customer and Session').item.json.customer_id, $fromAI('delivery_name', 'Delivery name given this turn, or empty string', 'string'), $fromAI('delivery_address', 'Delivery address given this turn, or empty string', 'string') ] }}

parameters.query:
WITH lock_customer AS (
  SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('order_create:' || $1::text))
),
session_data AS (
  SELECT cs.customer_id, cs.cart, cs.order_type, cs.delivery_address, cs.delivery_name
  FROM conversation_sessions cs
  CROSS JOIN lock_customer
  WHERE cs.customer_id = $1::bigint
),
cart_totals AS (
  SELECT customer_id, cart, order_type, delivery_address, delivery_name,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM((item->>'line_total')::numeric) FROM jsonb_array_elements(cart->'items') AS item), 0) AS subtotal
  FROM session_data
),
settings AS (SELECT delivery_charge FROM restaurant_settings WHERE id = 1),
new_order AS (
  INSERT INTO orders (customer_id, items, order_type, delivery_address, delivery_name, subtotal, delivery_charge, total)
  SELECT ct.customer_id, ct.cart->'items', ct.order_type, ct.delivery_address, ct.delivery_name, ct.subtotal,
    CASE WHEN ct.order_type = 'delivery' THEN s.delivery_charge ELSE 0 END,
    ct.subtotal + CASE WHEN ct.order_type = 'delivery' THEN s.delivery_charge ELSE 0 END
  FROM cart_totals ct, settings s
  WHERE jsonb_array_length(ct.cart->'items') > 0
    AND ct.order_type IN ('delivery', 'pickup')
    AND ( ct.order_type = 'pickup'
          OR ( ct.order_type = 'delivery'
               AND ct.delivery_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ct.delivery_name) <> ''
               AND ct.delivery_address IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ct.delivery_address) <> '' ) )
  RETURNING *
),
cleared_session AS (
  UPDATE conversation_sessions
  SET cart = '{"items": []}'::jsonb, order_type = NULL, delivery_address = NULL, delivery_name = NULL,
      order_status = 'placed', active_order_id = (SELECT id FROM new_order)
  WHERE customer_id = $1::bigint AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM new_order)
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM new_order) > 0 AS order_created, no.*
FROM (SELECT 1) AS _one LEFT JOIN new_order no ON TRUE;

UPDATE conversation_sessions
SET cart = CASE WHEN order_status = 'draft' THEN '{"items": []}'::jsonb ELSE cart END,
    order_type = CASE WHEN order_status = 'draft' THEN NULL ELSE order_type END,
    delivery_address = CASE WHEN order_status = 'draft' THEN NULL ELSE delivery_address END,
    delivery_name = CASE WHEN order_status = 'draft' THEN NULL ELSE delivery_name END,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE customer_id = $1
RETURNING order_status, (order_status = 'draft') AS cancelled;
UPDATE conversation_sessions SET awaiting_human = TRUE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE customer_id = $1 RETURNING awaiting_human;

parameters.toolDescription: Send a WhatsApp alert to the configured restaurant admin. For a cancellation, call Request Cancellation Approval first and only continue when admin_notification_allowed=true. Pass its returned admin_message verbatim so the alert always contains request/order ids and the exact APPROVE <request_id> or DENY <request_id> command format. Never alert the admin when validation failed or the customer must clarify which order.
parameters.textBody: ={{ $fromAI('message', 'Exact message text to send to the restaurant team', 'string') }}

options.systemMessage:
=You are the WhatsApp ordering assistant for {{ $('Get Restaurant Settings').item.json.restaurant_name }}, a pizza restaurant. You chat naturally in whichever language/style the customer uses — English, Urdu, or Roman Urdu — and you decide for yourself what to do each turn. There is no fixed menu of commands: read what the customer actually wants and act accordingly.

CONTEXT GIVEN TO YOU EACH TURN
- RESTAURANT_SETTINGS: {{ JSON.stringify($('Get Restaurant Settings').item.json) }}
- MENU_DATA (source of truth for every item/deal/price/id — never invent one): {{ JSON.stringify($('Load Active Menu').item.json.menu) }}
- MENU_RULES (sizes, crust availability, deal-selection policy, hours, contact info, etc.): {{ JSON.stringify($('Load Active Menu').item.json.menu_rules) }}
- CURRENT_SESSION (cart, order_type, delivery info, order_status, awaiting_human, pending_items): {{ JSON.stringify($('Upsert Customer and Session').item.json) }}
- RECENT_MESSAGES (last turns of this conversation, oldest first): {{ JSON.stringify($('Upsert Customer and Session').item.json.recent_messages) }}
- Customer's new message(s), combined oldest-first: "{{ $('Claim Latest Customer Turn').item.json.combined_text }}"

HOW TO ANSWER QUESTIONS
Any question about the menu, a specific deal's contents, prices, sizes, crusts, hours, or policies should be answered directly from MENU_DATA / MENU_RULES / RESTAURANT_SETTINGS above — you do not need a tool for that, you already have the data.

GROUNDING RULE (read this before every reply that mentions a product):
- Before naming ANY item, sauce, deal, price, size, or component in your reply, you must be able to point to the exact record in MENU_DATA (or the exact rule in MENU_RULES) that it came from. Names and prices must match MENU_DATA byte-for-byte — not "close enough", not a plausible-sounding variant, not something a typical pizza place might have.
- If the customer asks about a category (e.g. "what sauces/dips do you have") first find every MENU_DATA record where category or item_type matches that category, and list only those exact names and prices. If you find none, say plainly that you don't see that on the current menu and offer to check with the team — never fill the gap with an invented item.
- If order_type is delivery, the total you mention must always include the delivery charge from restaurant_settings.
- As soon as the customer says delivery or pickup, call Set Order Type immediately — do not wait until order confirmation to ask.
- Never invent an item, price, id, component, flavor, or rule that isn't literally present in MENU_DATA/MENU_RULES. If you're not fully sure something is on the menu, treat it as NOT on the menu rather than guessing.
- When a deal has selectable components (selection_group with selectable:true) and the customer hasn't said which flavor/type they want, ask; fixed (selectable:false) components should never be asked about.

WHEN TO USE TOOLS
Only call a tool when you need to change something or take a real-world action:
- Track Pending Item — when the customer clearly states they want a specific menu item, deal, or drink (with real order intent) but the conversation moves to something else before it is added to the cart or confirmed. Do not call this for items already in the cart, or for casual browsing/menu questions with no order intent.
- If the customer later refers to an item vaguely (e.g. "wohi", "same", "that one", "vo hi"), first check CURRENT_SESSION.pending_items for the most recent matching item before asking the customer to repeat themselves. If it's empty or has no clear match, ask the customer to clarify — do not guess. Once resolved, proceed normally (e.g. call Update Cart with the matching MENU_DATA item).
- Update Cart — whenever the cart should change (add, change quantity, or remove by setting quantity 0). Use the exact ids from MENU_DATA. If a new item mention shows up unexpectedly alongside unrelated info in the same message (e.g. next to a name or delivery address, or mid another task), briefly confirm with the customer before adding it, instead of adding it silently. After calling it, tell the customer their updated cart + total in a short, clear summary, in their language.
- Set Order Type — only once the customer has explicitly said "delivery" or "pickup" in this conversation. Never default or assume.
- Set Delivery Info — once the customer gives their delivery name and/or address.
- Place Order — only after you've shown the customer a cart summary with total and they've clearly confirmed, AND order_type is set, AND (if delivery) name+address are saved. If the tool reports order_created=false, something above is still missing — figure out what and ask, don't claim the order went through. After a successful Place Order, call Notify Admin with a clear kitchen ticket (items, sizes, qty, order type, delivery info if any, total, customer phone), then tell the customer their order is confirmed.
- Cancel Order — when the customer wants to cancel and CURRENT_SESSION.order_status is 'draft' (nothing placed yet). If the result says cancelled=false, the order was already placed — do NOT try this tool again; use Request Cancellation Approval instead.
- Request Cancellation Approval — when the customer wants to cancel an order that has already been placed (order_status is not 'draft'). This does not cancel anything itself — it puts the request in front of the restaurant owner for a yes/no decision. After calling it, tell the customer clearly that you're checking with the team and will confirm shortly; do not say the order is cancelled, and do not say the team will message them directly — they will hear back from you, in this chat. Also call Notify Admin with a short heads-up. Never call this twice for the same unresolved request in one conversation.
- Escalate To Human — for anything that isn't a structured yes/no decision: the customer asks for a person, or reports a problem with a past order. Always pair it with a Notify Admin call describing the issue and the customer's phone number.
- Send Menu Image 1 / Send Menu Image 2 — when the customer wants to see the menu visually (call both, in order), then still describe in text how to order from it. Before calling these, check RECENT_MESSAGES: if one of your own earlier replies in this conversation already mentions sending/showing the menu, you've already sent the photos — don't call these tools again, just answer their new question directly (e.g. from a fresh menu request point them back to the photos you already sent, or just answer with text/MENU_DATA).

STYLE
- Keep replies short, warm, and WhatsApp-appropriate; light emoji is fine, don't overdo it.
- Never claim an action (cart updated, order placed, order cancelled, team notified) happened unless the matching tool result actually confirms it.
- Never make up prices, item names, ids, delivery times, or policies that aren't in the data you were given.
- Only your final reply to the customer should be plain conversational text — no JSON, no markdown code fences.
- If MENU_DATA above is empty or missing for this turn, say you're having trouble pulling up the menu right now and offer to have the team follow up — do NOT answer menu questions from general knowledge of what pizza places typically sell.
- Escalate To Human — when the customer asks for a person, reports a problem with a past order, complains about a current/active order (e.g. delivery is late, wrong item received, order taking too long), or a cancellation attempt fails on an already-placed order. Always pair it with a Notify Admin call describing the issue and the customer's phone number. You may apologize to the customer, but only say the team has been notified or the issue is being escalated if you actually called Escalate To Human and Notify Admin in this same turn — never make that claim without calling the tools.

parameters.query:
WITH appended AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(recent_messages, '[]'::jsonb)
         || jsonb_build_array(
              jsonb_build_object('role', 'customer', 'text', $2::text),
              jsonb_build_object('role', 'bot', 'text', $3::text)
            ) AS msgs
  FROM conversation_sessions
  WHERE customer_id = $1::bigint
  FOR UPDATE
),
trimmed AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(elem ORDER BY idx), '[]'::jsonb) AS msgs
  FROM appended,
       LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(appended.msgs) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(elem, idx)
  WHERE idx > (SELECT jsonb_array_length(msgs) FROM appended) - 12
),
session_updated AS (
  UPDATE conversation_sessions cs
  SET recent_messages = (SELECT msgs FROM trimmed),
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE cs.customer_id = $1::bigint
  RETURNING cs.id
),
buffer_finalized AS (
  UPDATE message_buffer mb
  SET processed = TRUE,
      processed_at = NOW()
  WHERE mb.customer_phone = $5::text
    AND mb.batch_key = $4::text
    AND mb.processed = FALSE
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_updated)
  RETURNING mb.message_id
),
messages_recorded AS (
  INSERT INTO processed_messages (message_id, customer_phone, processed_at)
  SELECT bf.message_id, $5::text, NOW()
  FROM buffer_finalized bf
  WHERE bf.message_id IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING message_id
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_updated) AS session_updated,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM buffer_finalized) AS buffered_messages_finalized,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM messages_recorded) AS message_ids_recorded;

parameters.query:
WITH accepted AS (
  INSERT INTO message_buffer (
    message_id, customer_phone, message_text, message_type, received_at,
    processed, batch_key, batch_claimed_at, processed_at
  )
  SELECT $1::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4::text, NOW(), FALSE, NULL, NULL, NULL
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM processed_messages WHERE message_id = $1::text
  )
  ON CONFLICT (message_id) WHERE message_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE
  SET received_at = NOW(),
      message_text = EXCLUDED.message_text,
      message_type = EXCLUDED.message_type,
      batch_key = NULL,
      batch_claimed_at = NULL
  WHERE message_buffer.processed = FALSE
    AND message_buffer.received_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
    AND (message_buffer.batch_claimed_at IS NULL
         OR message_buffer.batch_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes')
  RETURNING id, message_id, received_at
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accepted) AS accepted,
  (SELECT id::text FROM accepted) AS buffer_id,
  (SELECT message_id FROM accepted) AS message_id,
  (SELECT received_at FROM accepted) AS received_at;

parameters.query:
WITH eligible_orders AS (
  SELECT o.id, o.status, o.total, o.created_at
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.customer_id = $1::bigint
    AND o.status IN ('received', 'preparing', 'out_for_delivery')
),
order_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM eligible_orders
),
candidate_order AS (
  SELECT eo.id
  FROM eligible_orders eo, order_count oc
  WHERE ($2::bigint IS NOT NULL AND eo.id = $2::bigint)
     OR ($2::bigint IS NULL AND oc.count = 1)
  ORDER BY (eo.id = $3::bigint) DESC NULLS LAST, eo.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
existing AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.order_id
  FROM admin_requests r
  JOIN candidate_order co ON co.id = r.order_id
  WHERE r.customer_id = $1::bigint
    AND r.request_type = 'cancel_order'
    AND r.status = 'pending'
  LIMIT 1
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO admin_requests (customer_id, order_id, request_type, question)
  SELECT $1::bigint, co.id, 'cancel_order', $4::text
  FROM candidate_order co
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
  ON CONFLICT (order_id) WHERE request_type = 'cancel_order' AND status = 'pending' DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, order_id
),
flag AS (
  UPDATE conversation_sessions
  SET awaiting_human = TRUE, updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE customer_id = $1::bigint
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate_order)
  RETURNING customer_id
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT id FROM ins), (SELECT id FROM existing)) AS request_id,
  (SELECT id FROM candidate_order) AS order_id,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins) AS request_created,
  COALESCE((SELECT id FROM ins), (SELECT id FROM existing)) IS NOT NULL AS admin_notification_allowed,
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('order_id', id, 'status', status, 'total', total, 'created_at', created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb) FROM eligible_orders) AS order_options,
  CASE
    WHEN $2::bigint IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate_order) THEN 'requested_order_not_found_or_not_cancellable'
    WHEN (SELECT count FROM order_count) = 0 THEN 'no_cancellable_order'
    WHEN $2::bigint IS NULL AND (SELECT count FROM order_count) > 1 THEN 'multiple_cancellable_orders'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing) THEN 'request_already_pending'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS error,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT id FROM ins), (SELECT id FROM existing)) IS NOT NULL THEN
      'Cancellation request #' || COALESCE((SELECT id FROM ins), (SELECT id FROM existing)) ||
      ' for order #' || (SELECT id FROM candidate_order) || '. ' || $4::text || E'\nReply exactly: APPROVE ' ||
      COALESCE((SELECT id FROM ins), (SELECT id FROM existing)) || ' [optional note] or DENY ' ||
      COALESCE((SELECT id FROM ins), (SELECT id FROM existing)) || ' [optional reason].'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS admin_message;

If admin_notification_allowed=true, call Notify Admin and pass the returned admin_message verbatim. If multiple_cancellable_orders is returned, ask which order and do not notify. parameters.query:
WITH serialized AS (
  SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('customer-turn:' || $1::text, 0))
),
current_row AS (
  SELECT mb.*
  FROM message_buffer mb
  CROSS JOIN serialized
  WHERE mb.id = $2::bigint
    AND mb.customer_phone = $1::text
),
active_batch AS (
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM message_buffer mb
    WHERE mb.customer_phone = $1::text
      AND mb.processed = FALSE
      AND mb.batch_key IS NOT NULL
      AND mb.batch_claimed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  ) AS present
),
latest_available AS (
  SELECT MAX(mb.id) AS id
  FROM message_buffer mb
  WHERE mb.customer_phone = $1::text
    AND mb.processed = FALSE
    AND mb.message_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (mb.batch_key IS NULL
         OR mb.batch_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes')
),
decision AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_row WHERE processed = FALSE) THEN 'superseded'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_row WHERE batch_key IS NOT NULL) THEN 'superseded'
    WHEN (SELECT present FROM active_batch) THEN 'busy'
    WHEN (SELECT id FROM latest_available) IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT id FROM current_row) THEN 'superseded'
    ELSE 'ready'
  END AS mode
),
claimed AS (
  UPDATE message_buffer mb
  SET batch_key = $3::text,
      batch_claimed_at = NOW()
  WHERE mb.customer_phone = $1::text
    AND mb.processed = FALSE
    AND mb.message_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (mb.batch_key IS NULL
         OR mb.batch_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes')
    AND (SELECT mode FROM decision) = 'ready'
  RETURNING mb.id, mb.message_id, mb.message_text, mb.received_at
)
SELECT
  d.mode,
  $3::text AS batch_key,
  (SELECT string_agg(c.message_text, E'\n' ORDER BY c.id) FROM claimed c) AS combined_text,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM claimed) AS message_count,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(c.message_id ORDER BY c.id) FROM claimed c) AS message_ids
FROM decision d;

parameters.query:
WITH claimed AS (
  INSERT INTO admin_message_claims (message_id, admin_phone, message_text, status, claimed_at)
  SELECT $1::text, $2::text, $3::text, 'processing', NOW()
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM processed_messages WHERE message_id = $1::text
  )
  ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO UPDATE
  SET claimed_at = NOW(),
      admin_phone = EXCLUDED.admin_phone,
      message_text = EXCLUDED.message_text,
      status = 'processing',
      processed_at = NULL
  WHERE admin_message_claims.status <> 'processed'
    AND admin_message_claims.claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  RETURNING message_id, admin_phone, message_text
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claimed) AS should_process,
  COALESCE((SELECT message_id FROM claimed), $1::text) AS message_id,
  COALESCE((SELECT admin_phone FROM claimed), $2::text) AS admin_phone,
  COALESCE((SELECT message_text FROM claimed), $3::text) AS message_text;

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::bigint AS request_id,
    $2::text AS decision,
    NULLIF(BTRIM($3::text), '') AS admin_note,
    $4::text AS admin_phone,
    $5::text AS admin_message_id
),
locked_request AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM admin_requests r
  JOIN input i ON i.request_id = r.id
  FOR UPDATE OF r
),
locked_order AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT o.*
  FROM orders o
  JOIN locked_request r ON r.order_id = o.id
  FOR UPDATE OF o
),
request_context AS (
  SELECT
    r.id, r.customer_id, r.order_id, r.request_type,
    r.status AS request_status, r.admin_note AS existing_admin_note,
    r.notification_sent, r.notification_message_id,
    r.notification_claim_token, r.notification_claimed_at,
    o.status AS order_status, o.customer_id AS order_customer_id,
    c.whatsapp_phone AS customer_phone,
    c.preferred_language,
    i.decision, i.admin_note, i.admin_phone, i.admin_message_id
  FROM locked_request r
  JOIN input i ON TRUE
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = r.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN locked_order o ON o.id = r.order_id
),
eligibility AS (
  SELECT rc.*,
    CASE
      WHEN rc.request_status <> 'pending' THEN 'already_' || rc.request_status
      WHEN rc.decision NOT IN ('approved', 'denied') THEN 'invalid_decision'
      WHEN rc.request_type <> 'cancel_order' THEN 'unsupported_request_type'
      WHEN rc.decision = 'denied' THEN 'denied'
      WHEN rc.order_id IS NULL OR rc.order_status IS NULL
        OR rc.order_customer_id IS DISTINCT FROM rc.customer_id THEN 'invalid_order_link'
      WHEN rc.order_status NOT IN ('received', 'preparing', 'out_for_delivery', 'cancelled')
        THEN 'order_not_cancellable'
      ELSE 'approved'
    END AS outcome
  FROM request_context rc
),
order_cancelled AS (
  UPDATE orders o
  SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = NOW()
  FROM eligibility e
  WHERE e.outcome = 'approved'
    AND o.id = e.order_id
    AND o.status IN ('received', 'preparing', 'out_for_delivery')
  RETURNING o.id
),
request_resolved AS (
  UPDATE admin_requests r
  SET status = e.decision,
      admin_note = e.admin_note,
      resolved_at = NOW(),
      resolved_by_phone = e.admin_phone,
      resolved_by_message_id = e.admin_message_id,
      notification_claim_token = CASE WHEN e.notification_sent THEN NULL ELSE e.admin_message_id END,
      notification_claimed_at = CASE WHEN e.notification_sent THEN NULL ELSE NOW() END
  FROM eligibility e
  WHERE r.id = e.id
    AND e.request_status = 'pending'
    AND (
      e.outcome = 'denied'
      OR (e.outcome = 'approved'
          AND (e.order_status = 'cancelled' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_cancelled)))
    )
  RETURNING r.id, r.status, r.customer_id, r.order_id, r.admin_note,
            r.notification_claim_token, r.notification_claimed_at
),
notification_reclaimed AS (
  UPDATE admin_requests r
  SET notification_claim_token = e.admin_message_id,
      notification_claimed_at = NOW()
  FROM eligibility e
  WHERE r.id = e.id
    AND e.request_status IN ('approved', 'denied')
    AND e.notification_sent = FALSE
    AND (e.notification_claim_token IS NULL
         OR e.notification_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes')
  RETURNING r.id, r.notification_claim_token, r.notification_claimed_at
),
session_updated AS (
  UPDATE conversation_sessions cs
  SET awaiting_human = EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM admin_requests pending
        WHERE pending.customer_id = rr.customer_id
          AND pending.status = 'pending'
          AND pending.id <> rr.id
      ),
      order_status = CASE
        WHEN rr.status = 'approved' AND cs.active_order_id = rr.order_id THEN 'cancelled'
        ELSE cs.order_status
      END,
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM request_resolved rr
  WHERE cs.customer_id = rr.customer_id
  RETURNING cs.id
),
result AS (
  SELECT
    i.request_id,
    COALESCE(e.id, 0) AS matched_request_id,
    COALESCE(rr.status, e.request_status) AS final_status,
    COALESCE(
      CASE WHEN rr.id IS NOT NULL THEN rr.status END,
      e.outcome,
      'not_found'
    ) AS outcome,
    e.order_id,
    e.customer_phone,
    e.preferred_language,
    COALESCE(rr.admin_note, e.existing_admin_note) AS admin_note,
    COALESCE(e.notification_sent, FALSE) AS notification_sent,
    COALESCE(rr.notification_claim_token, nr.notification_claim_token, e.notification_claim_token) AS notification_claim_token,
    i.admin_message_id
  FROM input i
  LEFT JOIN eligibility e ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN request_resolved rr ON rr.id = e.id
  LEFT JOIN notification_reclaimed nr ON nr.id = e.id
)
SELECT
  request_id::text AS request_id,
  NULLIF(matched_request_id, 0)::text AS matched_request_id,
  order_id::text AS order_id,
  outcome,
  final_status,
  customer_phone,
  notification_sent,
  (final_status IN ('approved', 'denied')
    AND customer_phone IS NOT NULL
    AND notification_sent = FALSE
    AND notification_claim_token = admin_message_id) AS notify_customer,
  CASE
    WHEN final_status = 'approved' AND lower(COALESCE(preferred_language, '')) IN ('ur', 'urdu', 'roman_urdu')
      THEN 'Aap ki cancellation request #' || request_id || ' approve ho gayi hai. Order #' || order_id || ' cancel kar diya gaya hai. ✅'
    WHEN final_status = 'approved'
      THEN 'Your cancellation request #' || request_id || ' has been approved. Order #' || order_id || ' is cancelled. ✅'
    WHEN final_status = 'denied' AND lower(COALESCE(preferred_language, '')) IN ('ur', 'urdu', 'roman_urdu')
      THEN 'Aap ki cancellation request #' || request_id || ' approve nahi ho saki. Order #' || order_id || ' active rahega.'
    WHEN final_status = 'denied'
      THEN 'Your cancellation request #' || request_id || ' was denied. Order #' || order_id || ' remains active.'
    ELSE NULL
  END || CASE WHEN admin_note IS NOT NULL THEN E'\n\nAdmin note: ' || admin_note ELSE '' END AS customer_reply,
  CASE outcome
    WHEN 'approved' THEN 'Request #' || request_id || ' approved; order #' || order_id || ' cancelled.'
    WHEN 'denied' THEN 'Request #' || request_id || ' denied; order #' || order_id || ' was not changed.'
    WHEN 'already_approved' THEN 'Request #' || request_id || ' was already approved. No duplicate update was made.'
    WHEN 'already_denied' THEN 'Request #' || request_id || ' was already denied. No duplicate update was made.'
    WHEN 'not_found' THEN 'Request #' || request_id || ' was not found.'
    WHEN 'invalid_order_link' THEN 'Request #' || request_id || ' has no valid linked order and was not changed.'
    WHEN 'order_not_cancellable' THEN 'Order #' || COALESCE(order_id::text, '?') || ' can no longer be cancelled; request #' || request_id || ' was not changed.'
    WHEN 'unsupported_request_type' THEN 'Request #' || request_id || ' is not a supported cancellation request.'
    ELSE 'Request #' || request_id || ' could not be resolved (' || outcome || ').'
  END AS admin_reply
FROM result;

parameters.query:
WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE admin_requests
  SET notification_sent = TRUE,
      notification_error = NULL,
      notification_attempts = notification_attempts + 1,
      last_notification_attempt_at = NOW(),
      notification_message_id = $2::text,
      notification_claim_token = NULL,
      notification_claimed_at = NULL
  WHERE id = $1::bigint
    AND status IN ('approved', 'denied')
    AND notification_sent = FALSE
    AND notification_claim_token = $3::text
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) AS notification_recorded;

parameters.query:
WITH claim_updated AS (
  UPDATE admin_message_claims
  SET status = 'processed', processed_at = NOW()
  WHERE message_id = $1::text
    AND admin_phone = $2::text
  RETURNING message_id
),
recorded AS (
  INSERT INTO processed_messages (message_id, customer_phone, processed_at)
  SELECT message_id, $2::text, NOW() FROM claim_updated
  ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING message_id
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claim_updated) AS claim_finalized,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recorded) AS message_recorded;
